messages:
frank: Hey docs — customer hit two issues in Private install: (1) the Security Groups example doesn't show an explicit egress rule for KMS during sealed installs, and (2) the HSM notes lack a short Terraform snippet. Can we add tiny, copy-paste examples for both?

anya: Good catch. I can add a minimal SG egress example and a short Terraform resource for customers provisioning a NAT/egress rule. Keep it 4-6 lines.

rachel: Also please include a 1-line Pulumi (TS) equivalent — a lot of infra teams use Pulumi and ask for examples. And add a brief note about HSM socket ownership + systemd ExecStartPre.

frank: Proposed SG snippet for docs (to be added under Private networking quickstart):
```hcl
# minimal SG egress for KMS access
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "kms_egress" {
  type              = "egress"
  from_port         = 0
  to_port           = 0
  protocol          = "-1"
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.redwood.id
  cidr_blocks       = ["10.0.0.0/8"]
}
```

anya: Pulumi TypeScript one-liner to mirror that: 
```ts
// pulumi: allow internal egress to KMS CIDR
const kmsEgress = new aws.ec2.SecurityGroupRule("kmsEgress", {type: "egress", securityGroupId: sg.id, protocol: "-1", cidrBlocks: ["10.0.0.0/8"]});
```

rachel: Systemd pre-start example: `ExecStartPre=/bin/chown redwood-installer:installer /var/run/pkcs11.sock && /bin/chmod 660 /var/run/pkcs11.sock` and a 1-line SELinux tip: `chcon -t container_file_t /var/run/pkcs11.sock` (optional).

anya: I'll open a small PR with these snippets + a short migration note that links should prefer stable anchors. Will also run link-checker.

buildbot: link-checker: no broken links detected in modified files.

frank: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1120 - includes SG + TF + Pulumi + systemd + HSM ownership note. Preview: https://deploy-preview-1120--docs.redwood.ai

rachel: Preview looks good, code blocks render and snippets are concise. LGTM, merging in a few. Thanks all! :rocket:
